item.text: {"search_note":"Search gap: I did not find reliable 2024 evidence that Abiy’s government broadly allowed peaceful protest or independent community organization without retaliation. The available record points the other way.","evidence":[{"title":"Ethiopia: Authorities must stop using state of emergency law to silence peaceful dissent","publisher":"Amnesty International","date":"2024-02-19","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/02/ethiopia-authorities-must-stop-using-state-of-emergency-law-to-silence-peaceful-dissent/","summary":"Amnesty said the state of emergency was being used to silence peaceful dissent through warrantless arrests, curfews, movement limits, and bans on assemblies and associations. This is direct evidence against allowing peaceful protest without retaliation.","question_ids":["3B.8","3B.5","3B.6","3B.1"]},{"title":"World Report 2024: Ethiopia","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"2024-01-12","url":"https://www.hrw.org/world-report/2024/country-chapters/ethiopia","summary":"HRW described the Amhara emergency as granting broad warrantless-arrest, curfew, assembly-ban, and search powers, and said security forces repeatedly arrested critics and journalists. This supports a broad pattern of suppressing dissent rather than tolerating it.","question_ids":["3B.8","3B.5","3B.6","3B.1"]},{"title":"Ethiopia’s Deepening Crackdown on Dissent","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"2024-03-04","url":"https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/03/04/ethiopias-deepening-crackdown-dissent","summary":"HRW reported arbitrary arrests, forced disappearance of EHRCO staff, and a climate in which “no one” appeared safe from arbitrary detention. This is strong evidence of retaliation and chilling effects against civic and political activity.","question_ids":["3B.8","3B.5","3B.6","3B.1"]},{"title":"Ethiopia: Halt Crackdown Against Human Rights Groups","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"2024-06-18","url":"https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/06/18/ethiopia-halt-crackdown-against-human-rights-groups","summary":"HRW said security and intelligence personnel followed, intimidated, and threatened human-rights workers at homes and offices. This is direct evidence of chilling surveillance and intimidation of civil society.","question_ids":["3B.8","3B.5","3B.6","3B.1"]},{"title":"In Ethiopia, a secret committee orders killings and arrests to crush rebels","publisher":"Reuters via EHRC","date":"2024-02-27","url":"https://ehrc.org/in-ethiopia-a-secret-committee-orders-killings-and-arrests-to-crush-rebels-reuters/","summary":"The EHRC head confirmed a secret security committee that interfered in the justice system and was tied to widespread human-rights violations. This is strong evidence that dissent was being met with covert coercive structures rather than lawful tolerance.","question_ids":["3B.8","3B.5","3B.6","3B.1","2B.9"]},{"title":"Details of State of Emergency Declared by Gov't of Ethiopia","publisher":"ENA English","date":"2024-11-03","url":"https://www.ena.et/web/eng/w/en_30124","summary":"The proclamation centralized coercive authority, restricted CSOs and media suspected of helping “terrorist” groups, imposed ID and movement controls, and suspended normal judicial handling of enforcement. That is broad administrative control, not space for peaceful dissent.","question_ids":["3B.8","3B.5","3B.6","3B.1"]},{"title":"Ethiopia authorities suspend three rights groups","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"2024-12-02","url":"https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/12/02/ethiopia-authorities-suspend-three-rights-groups","summary":"HRW said the government suspended three rights groups even as Abiy praised reforms such as media freedom and NGO registration. This is mixed on rhetoric, but the operational outcome was selective punishment of civic actors.","question_ids":["3B.8","3B.5","3B.6","3B.1"]},{"title":"Country policy and information note: actors of protection, Ethiopia, February 2024","publisher":"GOV.UK","date":"2024-01-12","url":"https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/ethiopia-country-policy-and-information-notes/country-policy-and-information-note-actors-of-protection-ethiopia-february-2024-accessible","summary":"The note says the Ethiopian Human Rights Commission receives complaints and that some institutions implemented recommendations on human-rights protections and prison conditions. This is the best weak positive evidence for some complaint handling, but it does not amount to a demonstrated right to protest or dissent without retaliation.","question_ids":["3B.8","3B.4","3B.5"]},{"title":"Ethiopian Justice Minister briefs diplomats about transitional justice policy implementation","publisher":"ENA English","date":"2024-12-14","url":"https://www.ena.et/web/eng/w/eng_5626876","summary":"The government said its transitional justice policy covers accountability, truth-seeking, conditional amnesty, reconciliation, and institutional reform after consultations with civil society and vulnerable groups. This is weak positive procedural evidence, but it is not proof that peaceful protest or community organization was actually protected.","question_ids":["3B.8","3B.4","3B.5","3B.6"]}]}
